Title: Death's Obsession
Author: Avina St. Graves
My Review:
Oh. My. God.
The nicknames, the nicknames!!!
The consent: He immediately stopped when she told him to.
The coaxing her out of her comfort zone
The healing every part of her that hasn't gotten to see the day of light after the accident
The speed the slowness the tension the passion
Oh. My. God.

Lilith is the victim of a car accident. She swears she dies and came back to life but no one believes her.
For years, a stalker — whom she calls the Faceless Man — has been leaving her Lilies in her work locker and secret letters with romantic messages. She hasn’t told anyone, as she’s already on medication and in therapy.

Her boyfriend is a bitch and a cheater. No more emphasis on that.

— the first spicy scene. HE didn’t EVEN FUCK HER. Zade Meadows could never. Doesn’t even compare.

Letum, the grim reaper, set up a very well cooked dinner for Lili and she is not used to this, because of tight finances. So she enjoyed her dinner and went to bed happy.

Then she dreamed, and oh boy did she dream.

The way the Grim Reaper took consent and then abused the fuck out of it oh my Goddddddddd

while he was doing his thing, Lilith said stop, I want to know your name; and he stopped immediately. Like immediately. No hesitation.

And during the entire process, he emphasised that Lili had to use her words if she wanted something, she had to spell it out for him. He coaxed her out of the hiding place inside her mind.
He made her relax. He made her happy again after so many years after the accident.

And oh MY GODDDDDDD THE WRITING THE WRITING THE WRITING

Melted my heart, fucked with my brain chemistry!!! The most beautiful writing I’ve ever read.
